name: 10522-lorashortprefill-7b-1gpu
model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf, served with the LoRA adapter yard1/llama-2-7b-sql-lora-test (rank 8) attached to every request
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine. No router, no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query and 32 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, vocab 32000, fp16, 4096-token window; 6.7B params, ~13.5 GB fp16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1500 requests with a 900 s safety cap, static seed 10522.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`: 128 prompt tokens in (min = max), 8 tokens out, one turn, greedy, prompts drawn fresh per request with no shared prefix; every request is routed to the adapter named in `scenario.json: backend.lora_modules`, so there is no un-adapted traffic in the mix.
purpose: A SQL assistant on a 7B model with a LoRA adapter, serving four concurrent users short prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Flat `key: value` only -- an indented line is skipped, so a
# structured value must stay on ONE line or the key is dropped and the engine starts without it.

model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf
enable-lora: true
max-lora-rank: 8
max-loras: 1
tensor-parallel-size: 1
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
enable-prefix-caching: false
